name: Pivot Reports for Jira
tagline: Pivot tables and charts over any JQL, with drill-down, CSV export, saved reports and dashboard gadgets. Free for 10 users, then US$1 per user.
highlights: Rows, columns and a measure, on live JQL
Pick a source, any field for rows and columns, a measure such as count or story points, and get a pivot whose subtotals and grand total always reconcile.
Bar, stacked, line, pie and donut charts; click any cell to see the issues behind it; export the table as CSV with formula injection blocked.
Keep reports private or share them per project, and put any saved report on a dashboard as a gadget that renders the same numbers.
